theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (m : ℕ) (β σ : ℝ) (x₀ : Euclid (n + k)), 1 ≤ m → 0 < β → 0 < σ → closedBall x₀ (4 * σ) ⊆ U → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ (4 * σ), ∃ θ : ℝ, θ < (m : ℝ) - β ∧ HasMassDensity T y θ) → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → μH[(n : ℝ) - 3 + α] {x | x ∈ ball x₀ σ ∧ ∃ θ : ℝ, (m : ℝ) - 1 + β ≤ θ ∧ HasMassDensity T x θ} = 0
